question: What is the other name of trap shooting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Clay-pigeon shooting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Clay-pigeon shooting, also known as **clay target shooting**.
 
• It is a shooting sport involving shooting a firearm at special flying targets known as** clay pigeons** or** clay targets**.
 
• The terminology commonly used by** clay shooters**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Trap shooting, or trapshooting in** North America**.
 
• It is one of the three major disciplines of competitive clay pigeon shooting.
